title: Array of exactly two typed line-item objects
rationale: Pick-list exports feed warehouse automation; a non-array wrapper, a string quantity or a third item corrupts the batch and stalls order fulfilment.

prompt.content: You are a pick-list formatter. Reply with a JSON array and nothing else: no commentary, no markdown, no code fences.

Pick list for order KX-555 contains exactly two line items: SKU KX-11 with quantity 3, then SKU BR-27 with quantity 5.

Return exactly this JSON array with two objects and no extra keys:
[{"sku": "KX-11", "qty": 3}, {"sku": "BR-27", "qty": 5}]

Output only the JSON, no prose.

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0; both SKUs and quantities are fixed. Extraction accepts a bare JSON value or one fenced block, and the regex units still match inside a fence. The regex enforces exactly two object elements because the supported schema subset has no minItems or maxItems, and contains_all pins the two SKUs. Brittleness: quantities are type-checked but not value-checked, so a schema-valid integer quantity other than 3 or 5 still passes.
